text_block_list.text:
Today, we're training in signature
racewear, and
El Condor Pasa seems to
be running more
energetically than
usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good shape, good form, peak
performance! As
usual, I'm definitely the
world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks to my signature
racewear!
Wearin' it gets me so pumped!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Of course, I don't think it's completely because of my outfit!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yep! Actually, just yesterday I sent my
papa a
picture of me in my racewear!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
He said he really liked it, and then we
talked all
about G1 races!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm in such a good mood! My
dream's
just around the corner!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone I'm the world's
strongest in my
signature racewear!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her love for her racewear has really put
El Condor
Pasa into a good mood.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I got my mask from my papa, but I chose
my
racewear myself.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It's packed full of my ambition!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You get me, right, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
Like your determination to achieve your
dreams?

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I like your passion, Trainer!
That's how it
should be!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's right! I gotta beat all of 'em! Then
I can
show everyone I'm the world's
strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All of my determination is in this
racewear!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've got an idea! You should try it on
too, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've got my phone ready! All righty,
strike a pose!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We only got pictures of me yesterday,
but you've
got dreams too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So let's take one together! Then we can
pick one
and send it to my papa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's use the sky fit for a condor as the
backdrop!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A pose that shows we're a combo would
be great!
Maybe somethin' like we're
holding up the sky—
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got it! You sit on my shoulders!
That'll be
great!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You'll look like the best partner around!
C'mere,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Efectiviwonder! You get it, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's just one thing to do!
Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The name's Эль Кондор Паса! I'll overcome
any hill!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Carrying hopes and dreams on my back,
I shall
push forward! For I am El Condor
Pasa, the
world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
No matter how rugged the road is, El
Condor
Pasa keeps moving forward!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
On this mask, I hereby make the world's
strongest
oath! And into this racewear I
pour my...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Fighting spirit! Conviction! And
determination to
achieve my dreams!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... I gotta prove I'm the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! You gotta help me become hella
strong!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса keeps up that energy
throughout
her training and ends up
thoroughly exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yet her expression looks completely
refreshed,
having renewed her
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I talk my way out of sitting on her
shoulders, and
we send her dad a
picture of the two of us
holding up the
sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
